about.name: Erick De Vasconcelos
about.body1: Erick De Vasconcelos is a director and executive producer based in São Paulo.
about.body2: His work combines cinematic storytelling with large-scale production experience across branded content, documentaries and international productions.
about.body3: Over the years, he has collaborated with global brands, agencies and production teams across Brazil and abroad.
about.studioBody: The studio combines cinematic direction with operational execution across pre-production, production and post.
about.servicesBody: EVS also supports international productions filming in Brazil through local coordination and production services.
